title: OCaml Temporal native client start request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge. Runtime validators also enforce 65,536-byte UTF-8 string limits, duplicate-key rejection, NUL-free identifiers, canonical payload encoding, and whole-document resource bounds. maxLength is the character-count bound expressible in standard JSON Schema; the runtime byte limit remains authoritative.

memo.description: Named payloads copied to Temporal memo fields.

search_attributes.description: Named payloads copied to Temporal indexed search attributes.

id_conflict_policy.description: Temporal WorkflowIdConflictPolicy applied when workflow_id already has an open run. Always sent explicitly by the OCaml encoder; an omitted member means fail.

id_reuse_policy.description: Temporal WorkflowIdReusePolicy applied when workflow_id's latest run is closed (#499). Always sent explicitly by the OCaml encoder; an omitted member means allow_duplicate. The deprecated terminate_if_running value is not accepted.

execution_timeout_ms.description: Workflow execution timeout in milliseconds, across retries and continue-as-new runs. Omitted means unlimited.

run_timeout_ms.description: Workflow run timeout in milliseconds. Runtime validation also rejects a value above execution_timeout_ms. Omitted means the execution timeout or unlimited.

task_timeout_ms.description: Workflow task timeout in milliseconds. Runtime validation also rejects a value above run_timeout_ms, or above execution_timeout_ms when there is no run timeout, because Temporal would silently lower it. Omitted means the server default of ten seconds.

retry_policy.description: Server-side workflow retry policy, in the same lossless shape as activity commands. Omitted means the workflow is not retried.

rpc_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller deadline for this start RPC in milliseconds, replacing the ten-second default. It bounds only the client call, never the workflow, and is ignored when a pending start with the same request ID is compared with a retry. When it expires the start outcome is uncertain.
